course_name_original: Einführung in die Finite Elemente Methoden
prerequisites: Knowledge of Mechanics (especially Statics, basics of Strength of Materials, Continuum Mechanics, Dynamics)
Knowledge of Numerical Methods in Engineering Sciences

learning_outcomes.text: Describe the requirements for the use of FE methods.
Summarize concisely the basic knowledge of FE theory.
Present the possibilities of FE application.
Use FE programs to solve defined tasks according to specified criteria.
Plan FE models for given problems.
Perform calculations on the influence of model assumptions, boundary conditions, and discretization.
Write their own FE software under guidance.
Transfer the content taught in the module to practical tasks.
Present results orally and in writing appropriate for the audience.
Plan a realistic work and time schedule.
Explain their own calculation method in their own words.
Constructively discuss feedback in peer feedback sessions.

syllabus_topics: Discretization and solution of a given differential equation with the Finite Element Method
Application problems relevant to mechanical engineering (e.g., structural or fluid mechanics)
Common sources of error in the use of simulation techniques
assessment_rules: The examination modalities are to be specified in the information system for studies and teaching for each course before the start of the semester.
